required_proof_artifacts: One source-to-notes traceability row for every source heading, paragraph, bullet, example, table row, warning and procedure.
Exact source page and source text anchor for every mapped note.
Separate Japanese, furigana, Romaji, English and Sinhala review status; no language marked passed from field presence alone.
A numeric audit table for every measurement, conversion, formula, threshold, date/time example and worked calculation.
An image inventory of all 172 repository assets with visual inspection result, source page, topic/lesson mapping, duplicate/irrelevant flag and provenance.
A coverage gate that fails release if any source item has no app note or is marked unresolved.
release_rule: Do not mark complete or release as fully audited until every source item has status VERIFIED_IN_APP or VERIFIED_NOT_APPLICABLE with evidence, and there are zero unresolved source items.
